column3: The interrupt handler of the 82527 CAN controller on chip select 5: loops while CAN_CS5_INTERRUPT is non-zero - codes below 3 are the status change / message 15 cases (reads CAN_CS5_STATUS and resets CAN_CS5_CONTROL) - code n reaches message object n - 2 at CAN_CS5_INTERRUPT * 0x10 + 0xffc7e0. No serial port is involved (was mc68k_serialPort2IsrHandler; PR #53 round 79)

Arms the J1708 bus timer: sets j1708_bus_timer_armed_flag - loads CTM4_MCSM11CNT with 0xfc8a - clears CTM4_MCSM11SIC bit 15 and sets its bit 14 (an interrupt level). It drives no TPU channel and takes no parameter (was mc68k_tpuTimerChannelEnable; PR #53 round 77)

The J1708 SCI interrupt handler: on QSM_SCSR RDRF (0x40) it reads the byte from QSM_SCDR into the J1708 receive buffer and adds it to the checksum - while transmitting it sends the next transmit byte to QSM_SCDR and at the end the two's complement of the checksum (~sum + 1) - and it clears QSM_SCCR1 RIE when the receive buffer is full. No EPS position sensor is involved (was mc68k_epsPositionSensorIsrHandler; PR #53 round 75)

Writes memory for a PGN 61184 write request (services 0x4b / 0x4d): a length cap of 1764 / an optional 10-byte key after the data / the region from lookupApplicationMemoryRegionType - 0 copied / 3 copied after validateSecurityKey (3 when the key is missing or refused) / 4 refused (10) / 5 EEPROM: 7 while not safe to program with RAM refresh on then the key (0x1a missing / 3 refused) then cm550_circularBufferWrite (0x0b when full) and the mirror copy / the other codes passed back. The same function as CM848 0x50af58 (shared name - CM848 returns 0x1a for a type 3 write without the key / refuses (10) type 3 writes into its calibration RAM while RAM refresh is on / has Bank 2; was cm550_memoryOperationDispatcher; PR #53 round 72).

PGN 61184 service 0x4b: request bytes 1-4 the address and 5 the length then the data - written through writeJ1939DiagnosticMemory. The same function as CM848 0x50b408 (shared name; was cm550_memoryOperationFromMessageExtended; PR #53 round 72).

PGN 61184 service 0x4d: request bytes 1-4 the address and 5-8 the length then the data - written through writeJ1939DiagnosticMemory. The same function as CM848 0x50b474 (shared name; was cm550_FUN_00021826; PR #53 round 72).

The request bytes before the data for a PGN 61184 memory service: 0 below 0x41 else j1939_memory_service_header_lengths[service - 0x41] (read from its base 0x21915). The same function and table as CM848 0x50b610 / 0x53a322 (shared name; was cm550_addressLookupFunction; PR #53 round 72).

Initializes the J1708 datalink: the secure write scratch pad - the diagnostic buffer pointers (cm550_diagnosticBufferPointerInit) - the J1708 receive state - the multipacket flags - the broadcast enable word (from EEPROM 0x47e) - the InSite parameter schedule (next due ticks from insite_parameter_schedule_table) - then the QSM SCI (QSM_SCCR0 = 0x34 / QSM_SCCR1 = 0x102c). Six startup functions call it (was mc68k_FUN_00029130; PR #53 round 75)

Processes a TSC1 (PGN 0) for the engine: the twin of CM848's processEngineTsc1Request (0x22d60). Byte 1 & 3 is the override control mode (SPN 695) and & 0x30 the priority (SPN 897); bytes 2-3 are the requested speed and byte 4 the requested torque. Rejects senders through cm550_diagnosticMessageValidator / cm550_diagnosticSessionValidator (the twins of CM848's ignored request and source configuration lookups) (was torqueControlModeHandler)

Unscrambles the 10-byte security key: each bit goes to the front of the work buffer when its security_key_scramble_mask bit is 0 and to the back otherwise / each work byte is XORed with the work byte its security_key_byte_order entry names / the output is written through security_key_byte_order backwards. The same function and tables as CM848 0x555cc / 0x5839a / 0x583a4 (shared name; was cm550_FUN_0002fbd8; PR #53 round 72).

Checks the 10-byte security key of a secured request: 0 (pass) when calibration_download_security_key_cal is 0xff; 1 once security_key_failure_count reaches 0x11 (a lockout after 17 misses); else unscrambleSecurityKey gives 6 characters (compared with security_master_password_cal) and a 4-byte hour meter stamp ((meter & ~0xff) - (stamp & ~0xff) < 0x1a): a match clears the count and passes / a miss adds one and fails. Called by writeJ1939DiagnosticMemory (types 3 / 5) and diagnosticCommandDispatcher (J1708 command 3). The same function as CM848 0x5573c (shared name; was sensorRangeValidation; PR #53 round 72).

The CTM4 MCSM11 interrupt handler of the J1708 driver (no caller - reached through the vector table): clears CTM4_MCSM11SIC's interrupt level and bit 15 and j1708_bus_timer_armed_flag - closes the received message (drops messages of fewer than 3 bytes and checks j1708_message_checksum) - and writes a pending transmit byte to QSM_SCDR. It drives no TPU channel (was mc68k_tpuChannelStateMachine; PR #53 round 77)
